messages.subject: jslider setup
parts:
Hello! I'm new here and my english sucks, but i'll give a shot =).

I want to set up a slider input attributes using a value that is assigned by a given user selected variable. This element must always exist.
I tried to implement it in the server.R, using reactiveUI(), but it creates a brand new element everytime the variable changes. Then, the ideal place to implement this is in ui.R and there is where my problem starts.

Is there any way to reset the initial value AND the position of the slider pointer everytime the selected variable changes without having to recreate the whole element?
In other words, I would like to change the 'value' attribute of the slider (something like sliderInput(..., value=someValueFromData)) and get the correspondent pointer position set correctly automatically.

I made two runnable examples The first one works fine but it's not what I want. The second one simply doesn't work. 
I want to be able to set the 'value' of the slider with mean(variable), for example, but i first need to know which variable was chosen by the user .

# Example 1 - Slider inside server.R -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
# ui.R
shinyUI(
  bootstrapPage(
    wellPanel(
      div(id="varSelectInputBox",
          selectInput("varSelected",
                      "Please, choose a variable:",
                      c("x" = "x",
                        "y" = "y"), 
                      selected="x")
      ),
      uiOutput("sliderSetup")
    ),
    verbatimTextOutput("print")
  )
)

# server.R
shinyServer(function(input, output) { 
  df <- reactive(function(){
    data.frame(x = 1:10, y=20:11)
  })
  
  varVector <- reactive(function(){
    df <- df()
    return(df[,as.character(input$varSelected)])
  })
  
  output$sliderSetup <- reactiveUI(function(){
    initValue <- mean(varVector())
    script <- tags$script(paste("$('#reactiveSlider').attr('value',",initValue,");", sep=""))
    return(script)
  })
  
  output$sliderSetup <- reactiveUI(function() {
    meanValue <- mean(varVector())
    return(sliderInput("reactiveSlider", "Slider with variable information in default set", min=2, max=20, value=meanValue, step=1))
  })
  
  output$print <- reactivePrint(function(){
    return(df())
  })
})


# Example 2 - Slider inside ui.R -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
# ui.R
shinyUI(
  bootstrapPage(
    wellPanel(
      div(id="varSelectInputBox",
          selectInput("varSelected",
                      "Please, choose a variable:",
                      c("x" = "x",
                        "y" = "y"), 
                      selected="x")
      ),
      div(id="sliderBox",
          style="display: block;", 
          sliderInput("reactiveSlider", "Slider with variable information in default set", min=2, max=20, value=2, step=1))
    ),
    uiOutput("sliderSetup"), #observe that the 'value' attribute changes with this operation but it is not effective
    verbatimTextOutput("print")
  )
)

# server.R
shinyServer(function(input, output) { 
  df <- reactive(function(){
    data.frame(x = 1:10, y=20:11)
  })
  
  varVector <- reactive(function(){
    df <- df()
    return(df[,as.character(input$varSelected)])
  })
  
  output$sliderSetup <- reactiveUI(function(){
    initValue <- mean(varVector())
    script <- tags$script(paste("$('#reactiveSlider').attr('value',",initValue,");", sep=""))
    return(script)
  })
  
  output$print <- reactivePrint(function(){
    return(df())
  })
})

Any thoughts? 

Thank you very much for the attention, and congratulations for this useful feature!

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: jslider setup
parts: We don't currently support updating the state of existing input controls, though it's certainly possible and even likely that this will become a feature at some point. I think most people have found reactiveUI works OK enough for these scenarios even though the entire control is recreated.
